metric: mIoU-style: mean per-record IoU over the full official split (grefcoco decomposition over targeted rows)
reading: Across the released HybridGL pipeline and the GLOD-RIS reimplementation, wrong-instance selection accounts for the large majority of the recoverable oracle gap on every dataset (HybridGL 77.4/80.2/86.4%, GLOD-RIS reimplementation values in the file); under-segmentation and boundary errors are the remainder. The same decomposition on gRefCOCO's released selection is included.
verdict: The diagnosis replicates across pipelines: the recoverable headroom is wrong-instance selection, not proposal quality, under both released selections. This is a measurement of both pipelines under one harness, not a judgment of either method.
